### `frx_fsm_state_t`

_Source: `lib/fsm_tools/fsm_tools.h`_

```cpp
typedef struct frx_fsm_state_t{
    frx_fsm_state_id_t id;
    frx_fsm_enter_t enter;
    frx_fsm_routine_t routine;

    void* ctx;
}frx_fsm_state_t;
```

Generic FSM state descriptor.

### `frx_fsm_t`

_Source: `lib/fsm_tools/fsm_tools.h`_

```cpp
typedef struct frx_fsm_t{
    frx_fsm_state_id_t cur_state;
    frx_fsm_state_id_t transition_state;
    frx_fsm_state_t* states;
    uint16_t n_states;
    SemaphoreHandle_t routine_lock;
    SemaphoreHandle_t snapshot_lock;
    void* args_snapshot;
    size_t args_snapshot_size;
    void* values_snapshot;
    size_t values_snapshot_size;
    void* block_ctx;
}frx_fsm_t;
```

Generic FSM instance. The application owns the storage.
